title: feat(debug): spawn timeline stats on the conversation
context:
"It took 60 seconds" was unfalsifiable: a Codex spawn crosses CCC ->
app-server -> Codex's rollout file on disk -> CCC's session list -> the
browser, and the user-visible wait is the LAST boundary, not the first.

Records a mark at each boundary, in ms since CCC accepted the spawn, and
renders them as a collapsed panel at the top of the conversation. The
summary alone answers the question; expanding shows where the time went.

The browser posts the two marks the server cannot observe -- when the
decision: Introduced server.py, static/app.js: added _spawn_timeline_enabled, _spawn_timeline_start, _spawn_timeline_mark, _spawn_timeline_get, _spawn_timeline_save, _spawn_timeline_load, watch_rollout, spawnStatsEnabled.
